# Bid the panels, the tear-off, and the trim.

> Price a residential standing-seam or exposed-fastener metal roof from the panel squares a per-square special cannot see, the tear-off, the stories, and the trim — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
